title: Buffalo Chicken Quesadillas
reject_reason: Buffalo chicken + Mexican cheese folded in a flour tortilla is the same dinner as live buffalo-chicken-burrito (protein, buffalo/cheese sauce, tortilla starch, skillet all match; bge 0.89); quesadilla-vs-burrito is a format nuance in an already-dense buffalo-chicken lane.
